Summary: Senior year was supposed to be simple. All she wanted was to graduate with her biology degree, spend time with her friends, and build a future with her longtime boyfriend. Instead, everything falls apart when she discovers her boyfriend Connor has been cheating on her, due to her not being as "experienced" as he would like, leaving her questioning everything—including her own confidence. Jason Todd has bigger problems than romance. As the star of the university hockey team, he's one failing grade away from losing the season he's worked his entire life for. Desperate to stay eligible, he needs a biology tutor—and the last person he expects to help him is his best friend Roy's younger sister. After an accidental drunk hook-up changes everything, they strike a deal: she'll tutor him, and he'll help her gain the experience she was lacking. But what starts as harmless practice soon turns into stolen moments, undeniable chemistry, and feelings neither of them planned for. With family secrets, broken trust, and the risk of losing the people they love most, they'll have to decide if some rules are worth breaking for a chance at forever.
